name: Lakeside Prisms
desc: Mysterious prisms scattered through the air near Amsvartnir. For some reason, they can be activated by Seelie.

imgDesc.text: Mysterious prisms scattered through the air near Amsvartnir. For some reason, they can be activated by Seelie.

Interact with nearby Intricate Blooms to rotate or move the activated prisms. Perhaps, by moving the prisms and reconnecting the fractured crystal pillars nearby, a long-hidden secret may finally come to light...
